Data Processing Testing Engineer - EUMETSAT - European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites, Darmstadt Job Search Search for Jobs 0 Saved Jobs Jobs Expiring Soon Search for Jobs My Profile Login Register CV Job Alerts Newsletter Career Guides Saved Jobs ( 0 ) Jobs Expiring Soon Login Register CV Job Alerts Career Guides Conferences Post a Job Recruiter Recruiters Guide Recruiters Recruiters Guide Data Processing Testing Engineer Saved Save this Job Saved Save Data Processing Testing Engineer EUMETSAT - European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites Darmstadt, Germany Within the Satellite System Ground Segments Division (SGS) of the Technical and Scientific Support Department (TSS), you will contribute to the development of future data processing systems within the Data Processing Verification & Validation (V&V) team supporting Spacecraft and High Level Production data of EUMETSAT and Third party mission operating on different orbits to provide a wide range of information needed by weather forecaster, climate scientist and other data users. The Data Processing V&V team is composed of highly skilled and talented people that are dealing with the latest technologies (current and future state of the art) applicable for data processing systems in space activities. The team will face and resolve challenging projects where thinking out of the box is essential and bringing innovative ideas is mandatory. You will work in an environment led by innovation and excellence. Joining EUMETSAT will give you an unparalleled opportunity to develop your professional path in satellite data processing. We are seeking a highly motivated, results-oriented person to join our dynamic team as a key player in driving our organization’s growth and success. If you are a collaborative team player with a proven track record of driving results and are looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply for this exciting role. What you’ll be doing As Data Processing Testing Engineer you will: Develop and maintain verification and validation strategies, methodologies, and test frameworks for current and future software and data processing systems, ensuring quality, reliability, performance, and operational readiness; Contribute to the planning, execution, and assessment of verification and validation activities across the full system lifecycle, covering system integration, qualification, acceptance, maintenance, and operational deployment; Drive the evolution of testing capabilities through automation, continuous integration and delivery practices, data-driven quality engineering, and the adoption of innovative technologies that improve testing efficiency and coverage; Support the investigation of system anomalies and performance issues, contributing to root-cause analysis, risk assessment, verification of corrective actions, and continuous service improvement; Contribute to the definition and maintenance of verification and validation plans, processes, and roadmaps, ensuring alignment with programme objectives, operational requirements, and future system evolution; Coordinate verification and validation activities with engineering teams, industry partners, and operational stakeholders, including chairing test results review and verification control board, reporting, review support, and communication of verification outcomes; Support the identification and evaluation of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and advanced analytics solutions, to enhance testing, quality assurance, and operational confidence across future systems. What we offer Excellent salary, of up to Euro 8,000 NET (after income tax) based on skills and experience; Flexible working time including additional flexi-leave; Full medical coverage for employee and family; Attractive pension; 30 days of annual leave + 14.5 days public holidays; Training and development support; Relocation allowance and support (if applicable). Requirements Qualifications: A university degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software or Systems Engineering discipline. Skills and Experience: Proven experience in engineering of Data Processing Systems or Products following well established processes, covering the analysis, design, development, integration and maintenance of large-scale software systems throughout the life cycle in operational, high availability and time critical environments using relevant technical standards (e.g. ECSS, CCSDS, OGC with Agile development methodologies); Proven and solid experience in engineering processes for managing requirements from the definition phase through the maintenance phase, including traceability, verification and validation using formal methods and tools (e.g. DOORs, Dimensions); Competence in the area of Data Processing Systems Verification & Validation (V&V) activities, including automated testing, software testing, unit test suite maintenance, software debugging and profiling; Ability to manage complex tasks with a minimum of supervision, including planning and prioritisation of activities, allocation and coordination of resources, monitoring and reporting; Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with proven ability to apply these to a team environment while working within a matrix structure; Experience leading/coordinating engineering teams and in the management of industrial contracts in relevant area will be considered an advantage. Languages: Candidates must be able to work effectively in English and have some knowledge of French. APPLICATIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH. WE WILL BE UNABLE TO CONSIDER APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED IN OTHER LANGUAGES. EUMETSAT is an international organisation employing staff from across all 30 member states and this role is being advertised on multiple international job boards, but please note that this role would be based in Darmstadt, Germany and would require international applicants to relocate if successful. More about us EUMETSAT’s role is to establish and operate meteorological satellites to monitor the weather and climate from space - 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. This information is supplied to the National Meteorological Services of the organisation's Member and Cooperating States in Europe, as well as other users worldwide. EUMETSAT also operates several Copernicus missions on behalf of the European Union and provide data services to the Copernicus marine and atmospheric services and their users. As an intergovernmental European Organisation, EUMETSAT can recruit nationals only from the 30 Member States (Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey and the United Kingdom). This is your chance to contribute to a world leading earth observation programme, set to generate global weather forecasting and climate monitoring benefits. As a Quality Assurance Engineer you will be at the heart of ensuring all elements of this complex system work together to deliver world leading meteorological products. In the EUMETSAT matrix organisation, the Technical and Scientific Support (TSS) department provides support to the development and operations of EUMETSAT satellite systems, in particular ground systems, as well as quality assurance and management support services to the full organisation, through its Process Assurance and Management Support Division (PRS). The selected Quality Assurance Engineer will be part of the TSS Quality Assurance team and closely collaborate with the engineering and scientific teams in TSS. She/he will be a member of TSS-led engineering development projects and will provide support to the maintenance and evolution of EUMETSAT operational systems and services and to other engineering-related activities adopting new technologies in line with the organisation’s multi-mission approach. Duties Provide quality and product assurance for the maintenance and evolution of operational ground systems and support services, including organisation of reviews and management and follow up of technical investigations; Define and ensure applicability of Quality and Product Assurance requirements for technical/engineering support contracts and monitor their implementation, including reporting and acting upon detected deviations, anomalies and non-conformities; Plan and perform project quality assurance activities in support to project management, including the definition and tailoring of the applicable Quality and Product Assurance requirements, organisation of reviews and provision of key project quality indicators, identifying non-conformities with regards to the applicable processes and facilitating the project risk management process; Provide Quality and Product Assurance support in acceptance processes (e.g. Incoming Inspections), tests related reviews (e.g. Test Readiness Review/Test Review Board), acceptance related reviews, management of anomalies, etc.); Provide Product Assurance support to the Ground Segment System, Software and IT Infrastructure components, including the provision of expert support in the review of related deliveries and during technical investigations and milestones; Define, analyse, and improve Quality Assurance processes of relevance to the TSS engineering activities, development projects and operations support services; Monitor the effective implementation of QA processes and requirements, and reporting on any relevant findings, gaps and issues; Participate in Internal Quality Audits and Quality Audits on external contractors/suppliers as necessary, to ensure their established processes are appropriate to fulfil the contracts they hold with EUMETSAT, in line with EUMETSAT requirements; Support the harmonisation and standardisation of organisational processes for all QA aspects, contributing to their continual improvement; Ensure lessons learnt in TSS projects are gathered, assessed, recorded and implemented/applied as relevant to subsequent projects; Provide Quality and Product Assurance training to TSS personnel. What we offer Generous salary, of up to Euro 8,500/month NET (after income tax) based on skills and experience; Flexible working time including additional flexi-leave; Excellent medical coverage for employee and family; Attractive pension; 30 days of annual leave + 14.5 days public holidays; Training and development support; Relocation allowance and support (if applicable). Requirements Skills and Experience: A minimum of five years experience in working with large-scale software-intensive systems in at least one of the following disciplines: Quality Assurance, Product Assurance or Software Engineering and general understanding of the others; Proven professional experience of working as part of the Engineering team or the Product Assurance team, in projects developing Software Systems, including its Software and IT Infrastructure components; Experience in Ground Segment Systems and/or software QA/PA would be an advantage; Experience readily applicable to the space domain will be an advantage (e.g. experience in aeronautical, defence, telecommunication or automotive engineering domains facing similar challenges and relying on related technologies and methodologies); Knowledge of system engineering standards and methodologies in aspects relevant to space operational systems; Experience in the definition and assessment of processes, good practices and/or standards in the field of quality assurance, combined with good knowledge and practice of the ISO 9001 and/or other relevant QA standards; Experience with new technologies such as cloud computing and Docker/Kubernetes and development methodologies (e.g. Agile, DevOps) will be an advantage; Excellent analysis, synthesis and presentation skills; Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to apply these to interactions within and between teams. Qualifications: A university degree in engineering or computer science (or another relevant discipline); Certification in quality assurance, management or auditing would be an advantage. This information is supplied to the National Meteorological Services of the organisation's Member and Cooperating States in Europe, as well as other users worldwide. Senior Software IV/QA Engineer - Test Automation - Thales, Esch-sur-Alzette Job Search Search for Jobs 0 Saved Jobs Jobs Expiring Soon Search for Jobs My Profile Login Register CV Job Alerts Newsletter Career Guides Saved Jobs ( 0 ) Jobs Expiring Soon Login Register CV Job Alerts Career Guides Conferences Post a Job Recruiter Recruiters Guide Recruiters Recruiters Guide Senior Software IV/QA Engineer - Test Automation Saved Save this Job Saved Save Senior Software IV/QA Engineer - Test Automation Thales Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg What we can do together: We are seeking an experienced Senior Software IV/QA Engineer to strengthen software verification and test automation across our products and projects. You will define and implement test automation approaches that improve verification efficiency, software quality, and confidence throughout the development lifecycle. You will work across digital applications, APIs, distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, and edge environments, acting as a technical reference for automated verification and software testability. Your responsibilities will include: Define test automation strategies based on product risks, verification objectives, technical constraints, and expected value. Design and maintain reusable automation frameworks and test solutions across applications, services, APIs, platforms, and distributed systems. Integrate automated verification into the software delivery lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines and representative test environments. Work with software architects and engineering teams to improve system testability and enable efficient verification throughout the product lifecycle. Analyze test results and complex failures, perform root-cause analysis, and support engineering teams in identifying product, test, or environment issues. Assess the effectiveness of test automation and continuously improve coverage, reliability, maintainability, and execution efficiency. Work with the Cybersecurity Authority and engineering teams to integrate appropriate automated security verification into the software delivery lifecycle. Provide technical leadership during projects, bids, customer discussions, and technical reviews on verification and validation activities, while promoting test automation practices and industry standards. Maintain the technical documentation and verification evidence required to support automation strategies, frameworks, test environments, traceability, and their evolution. About you: We are looking for an engineer with significant experience in software verification, testing, and test automation. Specifically, you should have: Min.7 years of experience in software testing, including at least 4 years of hands-on experience in test automation. Strong understanding of software testing, verification, and validation principles, including risk-based testing and defect management. Proven experience designing, implementing, and maintaining reusable test automation frameworks for complex software systems. Experience automating verification across web applications, APIs, distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, and edge environments. Proficiency in Python for test development and automation; experience with JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Rust is a plus. Good understanding of APIs, messaging, event-driven architectures, and distributed system behavior. Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and containerized or cloud-native environments. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across application, platform, and test environment layers. Ability to assess where automation provides value and select the appropriate verification approach. Strong technical leadership and coaching skills, with the ability to develop test automation practices across multidisciplinary engineering teams. ISTQB certification or an equivalent recognized software-testing qualification. Additional skills and experience in any of the following topics would be highly valued: Testing software used in space operations, ground segments, satellite data processing, or on-board systems or adjacent industries. Advanced testing of federated or Kubernetes-based platforms and their infrastructure services. Embedded software testing, hardware-software integration, Software-in-the-Loop, Hardware-in-the-Loop, simulators, or emulators. Verification of complex mathematical models, signal processing algorithms, or physics-based simulations. Performance, resilience, fault-injection, recovery, or degraded-mode testing. Experience working in regulated, safety-critical, or high-assurance environments such as aerospace, automotive, or nuclear systems. Software engineering and verification standards used in space or comparable mission-critical environments, such as ECSS. We are looking for skilled and ambitious people as we continue to build our team and create a positive, diverse, and collaborative work environment. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering teams to embed quality at every stage, leverage modern automation frameworks, and help drive continuous improvement in our testing practices. If you are passionate about developing robust automation and elevating product quality through software, we want to hear from you. Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned Design, develop, and maintain robust automated test frameworks and tools for device software, focusing on scalable, reusable solutions. Collaborate with software engineers to define test scenarios, testable architectures, and drive quality through code. Develop, implement and execute advanced test automation strategies for embedded, edge, and device-integrated systems (Android AOSP, Linux-based edge devices, IoT gateways), including validation of device drivers, connectivity modules, and firmware updates. Analyse requirements and develop comprehensive test plans and protocols for a range of technologies, including service APIs (REST, IPC), WebUI, and over-the-air updates. Contribute to continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines with automated quality gates. Generate and maintain technical documentation, standards, and best practices for test, automation and quality engineering. Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and systems engineers to validate device performance, connectivity, and stability under real-world operating conditions. Must be able to commute frequently to London-based office; 3~5 days per week onsite. Required Knowledge and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent international degree). Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in software automation and test development, or advanced degree with 2+ years relevant experience. Strong proficiency in software development for test automation (Python, Java, or equivalent). Hands-on experience with manual test management tools and test automation frameworks (Selenium, Appium, Espresso, etc.). Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps). Device operating systems (Android, Linux). Service-oriented architecture (SoA), APIs (REST, IPC). Hands-on experience testing embedded or connected hardware devices, preferably involving edge computing or IoT systems.
